description: One approved video per non-sequel show; short-form anime eligible. Prefer a substantive full trailer. Only when no suitable full trailer can be found may a teaser with meaningful show footage be used as a clearly labeled last-resort fallback (type:'teaser', verified:true, footageVerified:true, sequelStatus:'not_sequel', fallbackApproved:true, fullTrailerUnavailable:true). Automatically prefer full trailers when available, including in candidates. Never show announcement-only videos or fan edits.

entryExample.title: Official full PV (main trailer)
entryExample.note: Documentation only: normally use type full_trailer. If only a teaser exists after checking for full trailers, use type teaser together with fallbackApproved:true and fullTrailerUnavailable:true. Never use both in the playlist.

youtubeStatusReference.not_found: Checked, no suitable full trailer available
youtubeStatusReference.unavailable: Formerly approved trailer no longer accessible
youtubeStatusReference.note: Do not mark unreviewed shows as missing.

teaserFallbackExample.title: Official teaser (fallback only)
teaserFallbackExample.note: Example only; a teaser must still show actual show footage and be replaced if a full trailer becomes available.
